extra-a12e146a2baa.zh-Hans:
创作一段 30 秒照片级真实电影感洗衣产品广告，主角是一位年轻南亚女性，场景是明亮现代的家。全片包含与动作同步的自然女声旁白。声音应温暖、友好、清晰、口语化，伴有柔和真实的洗衣背景音，没有音乐盖过旁白。

0–5 秒：女子提着一篮脏衣服走进洗衣区，把篮子放在一台现代滚筒洗衣机旁。
旁白：“洗衣日从简单的一步开始。”

5–10 秒：她打开洗衣机，把衣服一件件小心放进去。展现真实的织物运动和自然的手部动作。
旁白：“我只需把所有衣服放进洗衣机……”

10–13 秒：她把洗衣液倒入洗涤剂槽，关上槽盖，再关上洗衣机门。
旁白：“……加入洗衣液……”

13–17 秒：她按下启动按钮。洗衣机启动的特写，衣服在玻璃门后清晰可见地旋转。
旁白：“……然后让机器来完成工作。”

17–22 秒：洗涤结束后，她打开机器，取出清新干净的衣服。她轻轻抖动并展开衣物。
旁白：“洗完后，它们出来时清新干净，可以晾晒了。”

22–28 秒：她把干净衣服拿到室外的晾衣绳旁，用衣夹仔细挂好每件衣物。微风让衣服自然飘动。
旁白：“然后我只需把它们挂在外面，让清新空气完成剩下的工作。”

28–30 秒：最终电影感镜头，刚洗好的衣服在温暖阳光下美丽地挂着，女子在附近自然微笑。
旁白：“干净、清新、随时可穿。”

温暖自然日光、真实南亚女性、现代家居、细致的衣物纹理、真实洗衣机、自然人体动作、流畅电影级镜头转场、特写镜头、轻微手持晃动、真实织物物理、轻柔户外微风、照片级真实高端广告品质、自然女声旁白、真实环境音、清晰同步语音、竖屏 9:16、无字幕、无文字、无水印、无标志。

extra-0bd47ffb66c7.zh-Hans:
创作一段 30 秒、1080p 超写实的 2000 年代初 DV 摄像机家庭录像，记录一对年轻韩国情侣在首尔度过一个悠闲下午的购物时光。女孩身穿合身的淡粉色上衣、奶油白色睡衣风长裤、白色运动鞋，背一个小肩包，深色长发扎成松散马尾。她男友身穿宽松白色 T 恤、深色牛仔裤和白色运动鞋。

他们一起逛商店，分享一个橙子冰淇淋，俏皮地互相喂食并大笑。他注意到她喜欢一个可爱玩具，偷偷买下来，在店外给她惊喜。随后他们去打保龄球，轮流投球后互相打趣。之后，他们独自走进电梯。他轻轻整理她的马尾，把她脸上的一缕散发放到一边。他们交换害羞的微笑，自然地短暂接吻，然后在电梯门打开时笑起来。

全片保持相同的面孔、服装、发型和外观。原始手持 DV 素材、不完美的构图、自动对焦拉风箱、轻微镜头晃动、褪色的夏日色彩、柔和的数字细节、自然运动模糊和真实的 2000 年代初家庭录像质感。自然环境音、笑声和对话。无音乐、无字幕、无电影广告感、无 CGI、无动漫、无美颜滤镜、无慢动作。

extra-06047b43bd5c.zh-Hans: 创作一段 30 秒 16:9 超照片级真实电影感动作场景。一位 20 多岁的西方女性，身穿深色夹克、工装裤、靴子，背着小背包，从摩天大楼屋顶走出，收到无线电消息：“撤离正在途中。”一架现代双引擎救援直升机接近，并安全悬停在屋顶上方。真实的旋翼下洗气流吹动她的头发、夹克、灰尘和轻质碎片。她自然地向飞机跑去，抓住扶手，在协助下登机，并在机舱内固定好自己。直升机逐渐上升，越过屋顶，在摩天大楼之间飞行。使用真实的人体生物力学、直升机升力、动量、风、旋翼下洗气流、脚步声、引擎声和城市声音，角色和光线保持一致，流畅专业的镜头运动，自然日光。无 CGI 感、无不可能的直升机运动、无瞬移、无过度灰尘、无夸张动作、无受伤、无文字、无标志、无水印。

extra-af7718f205de.zh-Hans:
一部真人实拍奇幻动作电影从铃音在风暴虚空中的破碎神社桥上遭到围猎开始，她借四块持续下坠的石板高速突围，摄影机在真实时间内紧贴她的动量完成一镜到底。仅使用 @[character ref] 确定成片中铃音的人物身份、服装、右手护臂与武士刀；忽略参考图的背景、文字、排版、姿势和构图，不让它定义环境、动作、镜头或敌人。

C2、C5、C6、C8、C10是五个彼此独立的剃刀爪兽，每只都有六条肢体、钴蓝色躯壳、浅色腹部与修长前爪。C3、C4、C7、C9是四个彼此独立的剃刀翼兽，每只都身形纤细、躯体钴蓝、双翼青绿、尾端紫色分叉、眼睛黄色。所有编号始终对应同一只生物，不互换、不复制、不融合；被斩开的身体块和断肢仍属于原编号。

整体采用完全写实的真人电影质感：真实演员比例与皮肤、织物和长发的物理响应，可信的重量、抓地、碰撞、惯性与自由落体；怪物以高端实体特效结合无缝生物视效呈现，肌肉、甲壳、翼膜和爪部受力清楚。破碎神社桥、鸟居和始终只有四块的坠落石板悬在雷暴虚空中，珊瑚红侧光与钴蓝风暴背光交错，尘土、碎石和湿冷空气形成深层空间。全程只用一支固定20mm虚拟电影镜头，保持超广角近远尺度、深焦和自然运动模糊；景别变化只来自连续可达的跟随、下潜、上升和包绕轨迹，焦距与摄影机实体连续性不变。

每次斩击都必须产生可见、真实的实体切割。刀刃先在接触点破开甲壳，再沿同一切线连续穿过组织，身体或肢体随即彻底分离；不能只留下光痕、浅表伤口或让刀身无阻力穿模。断肢与身体块保留受击前的线速度、角速度、重量和重力轨迹，彼此碰撞后继续翻落，不消失、不复原、不重新连接。剃刀爪兽的断口喷出荧光青绿色主液流与钴蓝色黏稠液滴；剃刀翼兽的断口喷出珠光紫罗兰色主液流与青蓝色轻薄液滴。所有生物流体均为非红色，珊瑚红只属于刀刃光效。

动作以正常播放速度保持原有的极高速与高密度，不因时长增加而拉慢。采用专业动画格斗般的短促压缩蓄力、瞬时爆发回弹、擦身斩击和不间断惯性贯穿，但所有身体运动、落点与碰撞都符合真人特技和生物力学。摄影机从不安定停驻；每个可读动作阶段只突出一个正在攻击或躲避的目标，其他生物仍沿已建立的背景轨迹运动。无剪辑、无定格、无慢动作、无撞击停帧、无复位、无传送，也不用前景遮挡伪装剪辑。

0-3秒：第一帧中，第一块石板上的铃音赤裸左脚占满前景，C2从右上方沿清晰斜线扑杀；摄影机立刻贴地流入低机位侧面全身构图，她在其腾空挥爪下方爆发回弹，以一次水平斩同时截断两只领先长前爪并横切胸腹。两只断爪、上半身和下半身在同一连续画面中彻底分离，带着青绿色主液流与钴蓝液滴按原冲量翻离。

3-6秒：镜头不停顿地包绕至低机位后方3/4全身构图，铃音右脚掠过第二块石板，C3从右上方收翼俯冲；摄影机沿她的下落弧线钻到下方并抵达贴地正面3/4构图，同一次回弹继续上升，刀刃从C3腹侧进入，切断一侧翼根并将躯干斜分成两块。脱落翅膀与两段身体分别旋落，紫罗兰主液流和青蓝液滴沿俯冲方向甩出。

6-9秒：镜头随动势升至高机位侧面，铃音左脚尖擦过第三块石板，借瞬间摩擦加速腰部旋转；C4以攻击性的S形航线横切她的通道，她用一次交叉斩从近侧翼根贯穿胸部，使整片翅膀连同一侧躯干被斜切分离。各部分沿不同角速度飞向画面左后方，断面与刀路完全一致。

9-14秒：镜头沿原路径降到她身后的后方3/4构图，铃音右脚触及第四块石板的垂直侧面；沿石壁疾跑的C5用两只运动中的长前爪夹住刀身，这个夹持只存在于一瞬。镜头随她滚转滑入紧侧面，她以接触扭矩把刀锋从夹持点旋出，连续切断两只前爪关节并剖开胸部，断爪和被分开的胸腹块脱离石面，喷出青绿色与钴蓝色体液后向外翻落。

14-17秒：摄影机从同一位置贴着第四块石板下缘滑到低机位侧面，倒挂的C6松爪扑出；铃音延续上一段身体弧线，以一次斩击横穿其浅色腹部，切断下方一对肢体并把腹腔分成两个不等大的身体块。所有分离部分因自身扑击惯性继续坠离，甲壳碎片和非红色液滴从真实断面向后喷散。

17-20秒：镜头以前向交接动作升至高机位正面3/4，C7收翼后以喙部领先做螺旋俯冲；铃音从螺旋轴旁掠过，刀锋沿头部至躯干纵向贯穿，把喙、头部和身体切成左右两半。两半仍保留相反的螺旋角动量，带着紫罗兰与青蓝体液分离旋落；铃音继续朝右下方坠向更多生物，镜头不作停顿。

20-24秒：从上一阶段的相机位置和运动矢量直接续接。C8从右下方一根正在坠落的断裂鸟居横梁上蹬出，向左上方截击；铃音用右手护臂拨偏其领先前爪，把反冲转成侧向滚转，再以上挑斩截断该前肢，并从腹部至肩部把身体斜劈成两个大块。两块身体向左下方分离翻落，较大的背甲半身保持可见。

24-27秒：铃音左脚短暂踏过仍在翻落的C8背甲半身，借其残余下坠动量向右上方回弹；此时唯一的主动目标C9从左上方折翼俯冲封住路线。摄影机沿双方交会轴下潜，刀锋以一次紧凑对角斩切断C9一侧翼根并将躯干分成两块；翅膀与身体块带着紫罗兰和青蓝液体沿各自轨迹分离，铃音重新转入右下方坠落。

27-30秒：始终与第四块石板保持相近落速的C10从其下侧松爪扑来，以两只长前爪合拢下降通道；铃音在爪隙中收身穿过，用右手护臂将一爪拨离中线，同时以短促反向斩截断另一只前爪并横断胸腹。断爪、上半身和下半身彻底分离并喷出青绿与钴蓝体液。摄影机随铃音越过这些碎块继续下坠，最后一帧保持她朝右下方高速离开，破碎鸟居下方仍有更多剃刀兽远景轮廓正在上冲，形成开放式持续战斗，不结束动能。

上述构图只是连续高速运动中各经过一次的瞬时取景状态，严格按时间顺序出现；它们之间由身体惯性、落体轨迹、接触反冲和摄影机可达路径连接。铃音始终只有一人，武士刀与右手护臂始终归她所有且结构不变。每次切割从接触到甲壳破裂、刀刃贯穿、断面形成和部件分离都在同一连续镜头内清楚发生；所有断肢、身体块、甲壳碎片和体液保持物理连续性，直到按既有轨迹退出画面。

武士刀始终带有贴着刃口的珊瑚色边缘尾迹，不形成远程剑波。每次实体切割只产生一道符合物种颜色的主液流、少量同色液滴与一簇青色甲壳碎片，全部从真实断面出发并随源速度运动；主喷流在下一次斩击前散开，液滴可短暂附着于坠落碎块。

声音为稀疏断拍脉冲配乐，持续的风暴狂风与远雷打底；石板断裂、赤足触石、衣料抽动、翼膜骤响、利爪刮石、护臂格挡、刀刃切开甲壳与韧性组织、断肢撞击碎石、不同颜色体液飞溅和怪物嘶叫精确跟随动作，所有撞击尾音迅速衰减以维持同样的速度感。无对白。
extra-af7718f205de.en:
A live-action fantasy action film begins with Suzune being hunted on a shattered shrine bridge in a stormy void, as she uses four continuously falling stone slabs to break out at high speed, with the camera staying tight to her momentum in real time in one continuous take. Use only @[character ref] to determine Suzune's identity, clothing, right-hand arm guard, and katana in the final film; ignore the reference image's background, text, layout, pose, and composition, and do not let it define the environment, action, camera, or enemies.

C2, C5, C6, C8, and C10 are five mutually independent razor-claw beasts, each with six limbs, a cobalt-blue carapace, a pale underbelly, and slender foreclaws. C3, C4, C7, and C9 are four mutually independent razor-wing beasts, each slender, with a cobalt-blue body, cyan-green wings, a purple forked tail tip, and yellow eyes. All numbers always correspond to the same creature; they do not swap, duplicate, or fuse; severed body chunks and severed limbs still belong to their original numbers.

The overall look uses a fully photorealistic live-action film texture: real actor proportions and physical response of skin, fabric, and long hair; believable weight, grip, collision, inertia, and free fall; monsters presented with high-end practical effects combined with seamless creature VFX, with muscle, carapace, wing membrane, and claw load clearly visible. The shattered shrine bridge, torii, and the always-only-four falling stone slabs hang in a thunderstorm void, with coral-red side light and cobalt-blue storm backlight alternating, and dust, rubble, and cold damp air forming deep space. Throughout, only one fixed 20mm virtual cinema lens is used, maintaining ultra-wide near-far scale, deep focus, and natural motion blur; shot size changes come only from continuous reachable follow, dive, rise, and wrap-around trajectories, with focal length and camera physical continuity unchanged.

Every slash must produce a visible, real physical cut. The blade first breaks the carapace at the contact point, then continuously passes through tissue along the same tangent line, and the body or limb immediately separates completely; it must not leave only a light trail, a superficial wound, or let the blade clip through without resistance. Severed limbs and body chunks retain the linear velocity, angular velocity, weight, and gravity trajectory from before the hit, continue tumbling after colliding with each other, and do not disappear, restore, or reconnect. Razor-claw beast cut surfaces spray a fluorescent cyan-green main fluid stream and cobalt-blue viscous droplets; razor-wing beast cut surfaces spray a pearlescent violet main fluid stream and cyan-blue light droplets. All creature fluids are non-red; coral red belongs only to the blade light effect.

The action maintains its original extremely high speed and high density at normal playback speed, and is not slowed down due to increased duration. It uses professional animated-fight-style short compressed wind-ups, instantaneous explosive rebounds, grazing slashes, and uninterrupted inertial penetration, but all body movements, landing points, and collisions conform to live-action stunts and biomechanics. The camera never settles into a stable stop; each readable action stage highlights only one target currently attacking or dodging, while other creatures still move along established background trajectories. No cuts, no freeze frames, no slow motion, no impact freeze frames, no reset, no teleportation, and no foreground occlusion to disguise cuts.

0-3 seconds: In the first frame, Suzune's bare left foot on the first stone slab fills the foreground, and C2 pounces from the upper right along a clear diagonal line; the camera immediately flows along the ground into a low-angle side full-body composition, and she explosively rebounds beneath its airborne claw swing, severing two leading long foreclaws with one horizontal slash and cutting across the chest and abdomen. The two severed claws, upper body, and lower body completely separate in the same continuous frame, tumbling away with cyan-green main fluid and cobalt-blue droplets according to their original impulse.

3-6 seconds: The camera without pause wraps to a low-angle rear 3/4 full-body composition, Suzune's right foot skims the second stone slab, and C3 folds its wings and dives from the upper right; the camera drills below along her falling arc and reaches a ground-hugging frontal 3/4 composition, the same rebound continues rising, the blade enters from C3's flank, cuts off one wing root, and splits the torso diagonally into two pieces. The detached wing and the two body segments spin down separately, violet main fluid and cyan-blue droplets flung out along the dive direction.

6-9 seconds: The camera rises with the momentum to a high-angle side view, Suzune's left toe grazes the third stone slab, using the instant friction to accelerate her waist rotation; C4 crosses her path in an aggressive S-shaped route, and she uses one cross slash to penetrate from the near wing root through the chest, causing the entire wing together with one side of the torso to be diagonally severed. Each part flies toward the left rear of the frame at different angular velocities, with cut surfaces exactly matching the blade path.

9-14 seconds: The camera descends along the original path to a rear 3/4 composition behind her, Suzune's right foot touches the vertical side of the fourth stone slab; C5, running swiftly along the stone wall, clamps the blade with two moving long foreclaws, and this clamp exists only for an instant. The camera rolls and slides with her into a tight side view, and she uses contact torque to spin the blade edge out of the clamp, continuously severing the joints of the two foreclaws and opening the chest, the severed claws and separated chest-abdomen chunks leaving the stone surface, spraying cyan-green and cobalt-blue body fluid before tumbling outward and falling.

14-17 seconds: The camera slides from the same position along the lower edge of the fourth stone slab to a low-angle side view, and the inverted C6 releases its claws and pounces; Suzune continues the previous body arc and with one slash crosses its pale underbelly, severing a pair of lower limbs and splitting the abdominal cavity into two unequal body chunks. All separated parts continue falling away due to their own pouncing inertia, carapace fragments and non-red droplets spraying backward from real cut surfaces.

17-20 seconds: The camera rises with a forward handoff motion to a high-angle frontal 3/4, C7 folds its wings and performs a spiral dive beak-first; Suzune passes by the spiral axis, the blade penetrates longitudinally from head to torso, cutting the beak, head, and body into left and right halves. The two halves still retain opposite spiral angular momentum, separating and spinning down with violet and cyan-blue body fluid; Suzune continues falling toward more creatures to the lower right, and the camera does not pause.

20-24 seconds: Directly continue from the previous stage's camera position and motion vector. C8 kicks off from a falling broken torii crossbeam at the lower right, intercepting toward the upper left; Suzune uses her right-hand arm guard to deflect its leading foreclaw, converts the recoil into a lateral roll, then uses an upward slash to sever that forelimb and diagonally cleaves the body from abdomen to shoulder into two large chunks. The two body chunks separate and tumble toward the lower left, with the larger back-carapace half remaining visible.

24-27 seconds: Suzune's left foot briefly steps on the still-tumbling C8 back-carapace half, using its residual falling momentum to rebound toward the upper right; at this moment the only active target, C9, folds its wings from the upper left and dives to block the route. The camera dives along the intersection axis of both sides, the blade with one compact diagonal slash cuts off one side of C9's wing root and splits the torso into two chunks; the wing and body chunks separate along their respective trajectories with violet and cyan-blue liquid, and Suzune turns back into a fall toward the lower right.

27-30 seconds: C10, always maintaining a falling speed close to the fourth stone slab, releases its claws from its underside and pounces, closing the descent path with two long foreclaws; Suzune tucks her body and passes through the gap between the claws, uses her right-hand arm guard to deflect one claw off the centerline, and at the same time with a short reverse slash severs the other long foreclaw and cuts across the chest and abdomen. The severed claw, upper body, and lower body completely separate and spray cyan-green and cobalt-blue body fluid. The camera follows Suzune past these fragments and continues falling, the last frame keeping her speeding away toward the lower right, with more distant silhouettes of razor beasts still charging upward below the shattered torii, forming an open-ended continuing battle without ending the momentum.

The above compositions are only instantaneous framing states each passed through once during continuous high-speed movement, appearing strictly in chronological order; they are connected by body inertia, falling trajectories, contact recoil, and reachable camera paths. Suzune is always only one person, and the katana and right-hand arm guard always belong to her with unchanged structure.
